این چشم‌انداز چارچوب جبران الکترونیکی در سطح پل Fe─C≡N─TM را برای توصیف سینتیک انتقال بار و ارائه اصول طراحی کاتدهای Prussian White در باتری‌های سدیم-یون معرفی می‌کند.
Advanced Materials | 💭 Perspective
💡 This perspective introduces a bridge-level electronic-compensation framework treating the Fe─C≡N─TM unit as the local descriptor for charge redistribution in Prussian White cathodes. Using Marcus-type descriptors (ΔG°, electronic coupling H_ab, reorganization energy λ), it defines kinetic regimes and translates them into design principles for redox alignment, cyanide-mediated coupling, and structural reorganization—offering a physical basis beyond Na⁺ diffusion or average structural views.
🏷 Prussian white cathode · sodium-ion battery · charge transfer · electronic coupling · Marcus theory

item.title: Mechanochemical-induced structural evolution governs lithium extraction kinetics in LiMn₂O₄ ion sieves
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Mechanochemical milling is shown to govern lithium extraction kinetics in LiMn₂O₄ ion sieves through mechanochemically induced structural evolution—a mechanism previously poorly understood. This links processing-induced structural changes to DLE performance, offering a design lever for tuning lithium extraction kinetics and advancing efficient direct lithium extraction sorbents.
